title: SB 3019 passes IL General Assembly
actions: Review the final bill text
Document vote tallies for future reference
Identify which legislators voted yes/no

title: Governor Pritzker signs into law
description: SB 3019 becomes law as the Digital Asset Tax Act
actions: Begin legal analysis of constitutional vulnerabilities
Draft press releases condemning the signing
Activate coalition partners

title: Rep. Cabello files HB 5798 (repeal bill)
actions: Rally co-sponsors for HB 5798
Begin committee outreach
Prepare testimony for potential hearings

title: CFTC Chair Selig op-ed
description: Calls it a "sin tax on blockchain"
actions: Amplify the op-ed through social media
Send copies to every IL legislator
Use as evidence in legal briefs

title: Summer Recess — TOWN HALL SEASON
description: Legislators are home in their districts. Show up, be heard.
actions: Find your legislator's town hall schedule at ilga.gov
Prepare a 2-minute personal testimony
Bring friends and allies — numbers matter
Record testimony (with permission) for social media
Follow up with district office after attending

title: General Election
description: Voters decide who stays. Make crypto a ballot issue.
actions: Check Stand With Crypto scorecards for candidates
Volunteer for pro-repeal candidates
Vote and bring others to the polls
Document candidate positions on SB 3019

title: Fall Veto Session Week 1
description: HB 5798 must be heard in committee this week.
actions: Flood Revenue Committee members with calls
Arrange in-person witness testimony in Springfield
Coordinate coalition presence at the Capitol
Live-tweet committee proceedings

title: Fall Veto Session Week 2
actions: Final push on undecided House members
Organize rally at the Capitol
Prepare Senate strategy if House passes
Media blitz during session

title: Possible Lame-Duck Session
description: Last chance before the new General Assembly convenes.
actions: Target outgoing legislators with nothing to lose
Push for emergency floor vote
Prepare legal challenge if legislative path fails

title: TAX TAKES EFFECT — DEADLINE
description: The 0.2% transaction tax becomes enforceable. Every second counts.
actions: File for injunction if not already granted
Activate compliance guidance for affected businesses
Continue federal preemption efforts
Document economic impact for ongoing repeal push
